description: A bright, airy dining room set within a curved bay window alcove. Three large double-hung windows with crisp white painted frames span the curved wall, fitted with softly gathered natural linen roman shades in pale cream, partially lowered. The walls of the alcove are finished with applied wainscoting panels in white, with a smooth plaster surface above. A round pedestal dining table in light natural oak with a turned baluster-style center column occupies the center of the space, surrounded by six matching upholstered dining chairs in creamy linen fabric on light oak legs. The table is set only with a large rounded white ceramic vase holding a generous bouquet of white hydrangeas with green foliage. A round braided jute rug in natural straw tone grounds the seating group. The dark espresso-stained hardwood floor contrasts with the pale rug and linen tones above. Through the windows, a lush green canopy of trees fills the view, bringing the outdoors into the composition. Bright, even daylight fills the space from all three windows, creating a clean and luminous atmosphere with minimal shadows. Camera is at standing eye-level, shooting with a normal lens in a centered symmetrical composition looking straight at the middle window. The full round table, all chairs, and the complete bay surround are visible in a wide establishing view.
